# Two methods, one dangerous space

Access to the tower exposes a sounding magnet, its intact line, the sluice lever and a diagram. The clapper can be lifted by the magnet or exposed on the dry shelf by closing the inlet and holding the counterweighted drain lever. Each solution uses objects already visible in this room and makes the other unnecessary. Both lead to the same conversation, but only one recovery Event may occur.

Reaching into the water fails safely: Mara withdraws before committing her weight. The magnet initially sticks to a wall bracket; pulling it sideways frees it. The drain lever slips back if released; its counterweight loop fits the nearby mooring pin. Hints escalate from the painted iron symbol to naming the magnet, or from the waterline mark to the lever's retaining loop. No timing reflexes or knowledge from the optional logbook is required. The clapper is usable after either approach; the later choice concerns Ivo, not a hidden mechanical penalty.
